shots.intent: 首屏抬升质感并一眼说清这是一盒能整张抽出的湿巾，抓着点击。
shots.textZone: 顶部中央 headline 与一行 13pt 副标 {selling_point_1}

shots.intent: 把薄巾一抽即断、抽出来变形的日常挫败放大，制造替换动机。
shots.textZone: 左侧居中文案 headline 与两行 13pt 标注 {callout_1} {callout_2}

shots.intent: 同机位俯拍两列对照，把抗拉扯讲成一秒能懂的视觉结论。
shots.textZone: 顶部 headline；两列下方 12pt 标注 {callout_1} {callout_2}

shots.intent: 放进真实看护时刻，让湿巾的取用位置与安全距离被直观看到。
shots.textZone: 右侧中段 headline 与 13pt 标注 {selling_point_2}

shots.intent: 微距交付纤维密度与含水的饱满手感，把不易破落到材质证据。
用俯拍阵列讲清盒装与补充装形态，让选款一步完成。
shots.textZone: 顶部 headline；每格下方 12pt 标注 {callout_4}

shots.intent: 回到干净克制的收口画面，把一抽到底的承诺与购买动作压在一起。
shots.textZone: 顶部 headline；底部 14pt 短按钮文案 {callout_5}

style.backgroundSystem: rough pressed terracotta board in #B4553A as the grounding plane, one plain unglazed clay plate in #D8C3A4 as scale anchor, matte unglazed ceramic, visible plate lip and board grain, no seamless studio paper

style.lightingSystem: single warm 4600K side key light from the left at about 30 degrees, medium-hard quality, one long crisp directional cast shadow stretching to the right across the board, deep clean shadow falloff, slight bounce from the clay plate, warm serene artisan mood
